title: Adaptive Conversational Risk Intake (ACRI) - Life Insurance Underwriting Framework
description: A formal, reproducible system for adaptive evidence triage in life insurance underwriting with complete decision provenance and cryptographic audit trail.
setup_instructions: Sample data is provided in data/sample_application.json
run_instructions: Custom: python3 code/acri_runner.py --config config/default_config.json --application APP_ID --data data.json

research_hypotheses.name: Evidence Efficiency
research_hypotheses.description: ACRI reduces unnecessary evidence without degrading risk selection
research_hypotheses.measure: Evidence requests per application (≥15% reduction, p<0.05)

research_hypotheses.name: STP Expansion
research_hypotheses.description: ACRI increases STP rate compared to traditional pathway

research_hypotheses.name: Targeted Evidence
research_hypotheses.description: Dynamic evidence selection reduces unnecessary lab orders

research_hypotheses.name: Underwriter Capacity
research_hypotheses.description: STP expansion frees underwriter capacity for complex cases

research_hypotheses.name: Risk Preservation
research_hypotheses.description: ACRI expands automation without degrading mortality selection
research_hypotheses.measure: Expected vs. actual mortality ratio (<105% of expected)

references.framework_paper: Russell, M.A. (2026). Adaptive Conversational Risk Intake and Dynamic Evidence Triage in Life Insurance Underwriting. Universal Standard Axiom Corporation, Working Paper.
references.reproducibility_capsule: ACRI Reproducibility Capsule - Complete Formal Specifications, Reference Implementation, Test Framework, Deployment Protocol.
references.white_paper_smart_store_csl: Russell, M.A. (2026). The Smart Store Cognitive State Ledger - Blockchain-Based Machine-Computable Legal Compliance.
